name: Generate humorous parodies and satirical lists
description: Users asked the AI to generate humorous, satirical, or absurd creative content, including lists of logical inconsistencies in game translations, parody reviews, fictional analyses, and rewrites of existing texts. The requests varied in format, ranging from short_lists and one-liners to detailed essays and SCP-style descriptions, but all focused on comedy and exaggeration.
